dialogues.title: Greeting a Friend
dialogues.description: Two friends catch up after not seeing each other for a while.

lines.translation: Nǐ hǎo! Hǎojiǔ bújiàn! — Hello! Long time no see!
Shì a! Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng? — Yeah! How have you been lately?
Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie. Nǐ ne? — I'm good, thanks. And you?
Wǒ yě búcuò, gōngzuò yǒudiǎn máng. — I'm doing well too, just a bit busy with work.
Yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn ba! — Let's grab a meal together sometime!
Hǎo a, zhège zhōumò zěnmeyàng? — Sure, how about this weekend?

dialogues.title: Ordering Food
dialogues.description: A customer orders a meal at a restaurant.

lines.translation: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn jǐ wèi? — Welcome, how many people?
Liǎng wèi, xièxie. — Two people, thanks.

lines.text: 好的，这是菜单，请看一下。
lines.translation: Hǎo de, zhè shì càidān, qǐng kàn yíxià. — Okay, here's the menu, please take a look.

lines.text: 我要一份宫保鸡丁和一碗米饭。
lines.translation: Wǒ yào yí fèn gōngbǎo jīdīng hé yì wǎn mǐfàn. — I'd like a Kung Pao chicken and a bowl of rice.
Hǎo de, hái xūyào bié de ma? — Okay, anything else?
Búyòngle, xièxie. — No, that's all, thanks.

dialogues.title: Talking About Weekend Plans
dialogues.description: Two friends plan a hiking trip, discussing conditions.

lines.text: 这个周末你有什么计划吗？
lines.translation: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà ma? — Do you have any plans this weekend?

lines.text: 我打算去爬山，如果天气好的话。
lines.translation: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù páshān, rúguǒ tiānqì hǎo dehuà. — I plan to go hiking, if the weather is good.

lines.text: 听起来不错，我可以一起去吗？
lines.translation: Tīng qǐlái búcuò, wǒ kěyǐ yìqǐ qù ma? — Sounds good, can I join?

lines.text: 当然可以！不过山路比较陡，你要做好准备。
lines.translation: Dāngrán kěyǐ! Búguò shānlù bǐjiào dǒu, nǐ yào zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi. — Of course! But the trail is quite steep, so be prepared.

lines.text: 没问题，我平时也经常锻炼。
lines.translation: Méi wèntí, wǒ píngshí yě jīngcháng duànliàn. — No problem, I exercise regularly too.

lines.text: 太好了，那我们早上八点出发吧。
lines.translation: Tài hǎo le, nà wǒmen zǎoshang bā diǎn chūfā ba. — Great, let's set off at 8am then.
